title: Brilliant Bacon invention.... For all Restaurants... Hear this !!!
text: Brilliant Bacon invention.... For all Restaurants... Hear this !!!. Why the image is not posted here is beyond me. Go to You tube and type in BakeyBacon.  Just got this today, half my family was here and the creativity got so competitive, we had a blast trying to outdo one another creating the best bacon delights. The silicone rods were so easy to wrap , and the clean up was simple. You actually can wash these in the dishwasher. One of my sister's chose to wash them by hand and was quite impressed, We all were. Terrific Gift idea for all you bacon lover's. I'm sold 100%. I wish they had these when I was in the restaurant business. I  know my customer's would have bought this great package they came in if we retailed it.  I'm a Fan. Thank you !!!

product_metadata.title: BakeyBacon Silicone Rods and Piping Kit for Baked Bacon Straws
features: Bakey Bacon - 6 Solid Silicone Rods for Making Pirouettes with all types of food - Especially bacon!
In addition - this comes with one reusable silicone pastry bag, a super extra large 5.6" inch Bismarck piping tip and Recipe booklet included for inspiration
For use in the microwave or conventional oven
Bake twirled bacon or anything else to create a unique straw that is hollow and can be filled with any thing you desire.
description: New invention to create a baked pirouette or straw from bacon to pastries! 6 FDA/LFGB solid silicone baking rods that you wrap and bake, then slip right off. No need for oils, as the rod is completely non stick. You can make creative new shapes such as bows, double helix, twisted twirls etc...
